name: What should I do to prepare for my first small-group training session?
description: Prepare by hydrating, eating a light meal, wearing appropriate attire, and arriving early to discuss any concerns with your coach.

mainEntity.name: What should I do to prepare for my first small-group training session?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before your first small-group training session at Cave Training, ensure you are well-hydrated and have eaten a light, nutritious meal a few hours prior. Wear comfortable athletic clothing and appropriate footwear. It's also helpful to arrive a few minutes early to introduce yourself to the coach and discuss any injuries or concerns you may have, allowing them to make necessary adjustments for your safety and comfort.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare by hydrating, eating a light meal, wearing appropriate attire, and arriving early to discuss any concerns with your coach.
